free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed torch seed for reproducible random projections and hidden states

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU float32 is the smallest dtype the real attention code runs in

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: small head count; the target condition does not depend on the head count

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: small even head dimension for rotary embedding; not used by the target condition

free_parameters.name: kv_groups
free_parameters.why: grouped-query repeat factor exercised by repeat_kv; not used by the target condition

free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: single sequence is enough; the target condition only depends on layer_idx/starting_layer/is_search

free_parameters.name: position_ids
free_parameters.why: identity rotary fixture uses unsqueeze_dim=1, the installed transformers signature
